Take the Financial Lead at a Global Pharmaceutical Player

Are you a seasoned accounting professional looking for a high-impact key role in an international corporate environment? On behalf of our client - a renowned pharmaceutical company headquartered in Cuxhaven (Lower Saxony, Germany) and part of a leading international pharma group with its parent company based in Slovenia - we are seeking an experienced Chief Accountant (m/f/d). In this pivotal position, you will take full responsibility for local accounting operations, oversee complex closing processes, and serve as a key finance partner within the global corporate network.

Your Key Responsibilities

- Oversee and manage the preparation of accurate month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial statements in compliance with HGB and IFRS.
- Lead general ledger accounting operations, ensure correct booking of transactional data, and maintain financial accuracy across all accounts.
- Manage and optimize financial processes within SAP S/4HANA.
- Act as the primary point of contact for external auditors, tax advisors, and local authorities; ensure strict compliance with regulatory standards.
- Collaborate closely with the finance teams at the Slovenian parent company and align financial reporting with corporate expectations.

What You Bring to the Role

- University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
- At least 5 years of hands-on experience in General Ledger and financial accounting, ideally within the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or manufacturing industry.
- Proven expertise in accounting standards under both HGB and IFRS.
- Solid track record in managing month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing processes.
- Proficiency with SAP S/4HANA and core general ledger workflows.
- Business-fluent German and English skills (written and spoken) to communicate effectively with the Slovenian parent company and international stakeholders.
- A structured, hands-on, and solution-oriented working style with high personal accountability.

Nice-to-Have

- Direct experience in audit management and coordinating with external auditors.
- Background in tax & compliance and international stakeholder management.

What Is Offered to You

- A key leadership position on-site in Cuxhaven with no routine travel requirements.
- A stable, future-proof working environment within the growing pharmaceutical industry.
- The security and backing of a global pharmaceutical corporate structure based in Slovenia.
- An attractive compensation package with negotiable relocation support if relocating to Cuxhaven.
- A culture that values continuous learning and offers true room for personal and professional development.

**Please note:** This role requires on-site presence in Cuxhaven with no hybrid work arrangement.

**Ready to take the next step in Cuxhaven?** Send us your CV. We look forward to meeting you!

Equal Opportunity & Diversity

We and our client believe in the power of diversity and foster an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual orientation and identity. Your qualifications and passion for the role are what matter most to us.

jobs.occupation: Systems Engineer Satellite Operations (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

At OHB, we take on some of the most exciting challenges in the space industry. We work across a wide spectrum of spacecraft missions — from single satellites to entire constellations, from LEO to interplanetary exploration, supporting customers in Defence, Science, and beyond.

In our Spacecraft Operations Development team, we want to shape the operational concept from day one. We collaborate closely with customers, write the user manuals for the satellites we deliver, develop the flight procedures that will guide operations in orbit, and support the mission from separation through handover — and often long after.

We’re now looking for a passionate and experienced Spacecraft Operations Engineer who’s ready to jump in, get up to speed quickly, and contribute from proposals all the way through Phase E.

If you have hands-on experience creating and validating procedures, if you’ve been part of LEOP and commissioning campaigns, and if you’re excited about influencing earlier mission phases to enable simple, reliable, and robust operations for our customers — we’d love to meet you.
This is your opportunity to leave a meaningful mark on space.
Your Qualifications

Required

- Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a similar technical field.
- 7+ years of experience in Spacecraft Operations Development, such as writing or validating flight procedures, developing operations concepts, creating spacecraft user manuals o supporting pre‑launch and in‑orbit preparation
- Hands-on experience in LEOP and Commissioning (actively participating in real-time ops).
- Strong understanding of spacecraft subsystems (AOCS, Power, TT&C, Thermal, Payload, etc.).
- Experience with Mission Control Systems and ground segment tools (e.g., SCOS‑2000, EGS‑CC, MCS look-alikes, automation frameworks).
- Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Preferred / Nice to have

- Professional proficiency in German (spoken and written).
- Experience supporting phases B/C/D, especially requirements definition, design reviews, and operations preparation.
- Experience with constellations, on‑board automation, or autonomy concepts.
- Understanding of ECSS standards, especially related to operations (E‑70 series).
Experience with simulator testing, procedure automation (e.g., TM/TC scripting), FMECA / hazard analysis from an ops perspective
- Familiarity with project management tools and workflows (e.g., JIRA, Confluence).
- Ability to work in customer‑oriented environments (ESA, DLR, defence customers, commercial operators).

Soft Skills (important for the role)

- Strong communication and documentation skills.
- Ability to collaborate with system engineers, AIV teams, and customers.
- Proactive, structured, and able to work independently.
- Problem‑solving mindset, especially under time pressure (LEOP, anomalies).
- Willingness to occasionally travel for reviews, test campaigns, or operations.
